institutions.title: Ngā whare ture
institutions.lede: E tautuhi ana ngā tāurunga i ngā rōpū ture me ngā whare mō te rangahau. Ehara te whakaurunga i te whakamana roma; tirohia te putumōhio mō ngā puna mātaki.
institutions.search: Rapua he whenua, he rōpū rānei
institutions.unresolved: Kāore anō kia mārama te mana hanga ture
institutions.defaultView: Kei te whānuitanga, e arotakengia ana
institutions.noService: Kāore anō kia tuhia he hononga ki te putumōhio
institutions.scopeCopy: E kapi ana tā mātou rangahau i ngā rōpū whenua 71, i runga i te Taurangi Manapori 2024 a EIU. Kei roto ngā whare ture o ngā rohe taumata tuatahi me ngā rohe mana motuhake whai tūnga motuhake. Ka whakarōpūhia ngā rūma me ngā rōpū hanga ture motuhake ki raro i ō rātou whakahaere ina tika. He rārangi e whanake tonu ana tēnei; he take motuhake te whakakī katoa me te whakaū i ngā ratonga mātakitaki.
institutions.relationships: Ngā hononga i waenga i ngā rōpū
institutions.contribute: Āwhinatia te whakapai ake i tēnei rārangi
institutions.contributeCopy: Kei te ngaro he rōpū, he pāhotanga mana rānei? He whakatikatika, he whakamāoritanga, he take āheitanga, he whakaaro kē rānei tāu? Nau mai ngā āwhina katoa, ahakoa te rahi.

institutions.noServiceNote: He āputa rangahau te kore puna mātakitaki kua tuhia; ehara i te tohu kāore he pāhotanga a taua rōpū.

project.title: Ngā raraunga me ngā tikanga
project.intro: He kaupapa waehere tuwhera e tuhi ana i ngā whare ture, ngā pāhotanga whaimana me ngā raraunga hōtaka.
project.inventoryCopy: Ngā rōpū me ngā whare, me ngā taunakitanga mō te mana hanga ture me te whānuitanga rangahau. Kāore tētahi pūkete rōpū e whakaū ana kei te wātea he pāhotanga.
project.catalogueCopy: Ngā puna ataata whaimana e hono ana ki aua whakahaere. He whārangi o waho, he pūranga, he pūpāpāho rānei kei tēnei whārangi te puna.
project.reviewCopy: He kitenga motuhake te urunga hangarau, te tuakiri, te whakahāngai roma me ngā mana whakamahi anō. Ka tūtohu te pūnaha aunoa i ngā panonitanga mā te tangata e arotake; kāore e whakauru aunoa i ngā puna.
project.productsCopy: Ka hangaia ēnei whārangi me ngā kōnae mai i ngā pūkete kua arotakengia. Ka penapenahia ngā wā hōtaka ki UTC, ka whakaaturia ki te rohe wā o te kaititiro.
project.cadence: Ka arotakengia, ka tiakina ki te putunga ngā panonitanga ki ngā rārangi. Ka whakahoutia ngā hōtaka me ngā kōnae kaweake ia ono hāora.
project.qualityFile: Te kounga me te kapinga o te aratohu
project.broaderFile: Ngā hongere tautoko katoa, tae atu ki ngā roma wā hui anake
project.limitsTitle: Te kapinga me te whakamahi anō
project.coverage: He wāhanga anake ka kapi i te aratohu. Ka tatau “Ngā hōtaka aunoa” i ngā puna e hono ana ki tētahi pūtātari kua whakatinanahia, kaua i ngā aratohu kua whakakīa. He motuhake ngā rārangi huihuinga me te kapinga XMLTV; me tika te whakahāngai roma kua arotakengia, me oti hoki ngā wā mō XMLTV. He rerekē ngā hapa kohikohi i tētahi wā hōtaka kua whakaūngia kāore he tāurunga.
project.rights: He motuhake te raihana waehere i ngā mana pāhotanga me ngā mana raraunga puna. Tirohia ngā tikanga o ia puna; kāore he raihana whānui e kīia mō ngā rauemi a ētahi atu.
project.docs: Ngā tuhinga rangahau me te manatoko
project.contributeCopy: Āwhinatia ngā puna, te rangahau, ngā raraungameta, ngā aratohu hōtaka, ngā whakamāoritanga, te urutanga, ngā tuhinga, te waehere rānei.
project.skip: Peke ki ngā raraunga me ngā tikanga
project.inventoryInclusion: Me whai taunakitanga te mana hanga ture. Kāore ngā rōpū kaunihera ā-rohe noa me ngā rōpū tohutohu e whakaurua; ka tohua tonutia ngā take kāore anō kia whakatauria. Kāore he puna mātakitaki e hiahiatia mō te rārangi rangahau.
project.catalogueInclusion: Me whai puna mana kua tautuhia mō te ataata, mō te oro rānei o ngā mahi ture, he mea pāho ora, he mea hopu rānei. Kāore ngā ara mātakitaki kāore e pai, e rangahautia tonutia ana rānei, e whakaurua ki te putumōhio. Ka āhei hoki ngā puna kei tua i ngā aronga rangahau; ka arotakengia motuhaketia te tāmau me te whakamahi anō.
project.scheduleInclusion: He hononga whaihua tonu ngā maramataka mana ahakoa kāore he kaikohi. Me whai raraunga pūtake hanganga ngā rārangi aunoa, me ngā rā me ngā wā mārama; kāore ngā wā ngaro e hangaia noa. Me whai hoki a XMLTV i te hononga whāngai tika kua arotakengia, me ngā wā tīmata me ngā wā mutu pono.
project.supportingTitle: Ngā raraunga tautoko me te rangahau
project.supportingCopy: Ka tautoko ngā tāuru kua tiakina, ngā whakataunga arotake me ngā taunakitanga whai rā i ngā kōnae tūmatanui. Kāore ēnei tuhinga e whakamana i tētahi roma mahi, e tuku motika whakamahi anō rānei.
project.contextFile: Te mematanga ā-ao me te horopaki mahere
project.mapFile: Te āhua mahere me ngā whakamihi
project.methodChecks: Ka whakatauritea ngā whare mana me ngā kaipupuri puna; ka tuhia motuhaketia te tuakiri, te urunga hangarau, te āheitanga me ngā motika. Ka tuku ngā arowhai aunoa i ngā panoni mā te tangata e arotake; ka pupuri ngā pūrongo whai rā i ngā mea i tirohia.
project.methodSchedules: Ka wehe ngā kaikohi i ngā rārangi pātea i ngā tono rahua, ā, ka tohu i ngā raraunga tawhito kua puritia. Ka hurihia ngā rohe wā o ngā puna ki UTC; ka whakaatu te pae i tō wā ā-rohe. Ehara noa te maramataka hui i te aratohu hōtaka pouaka whakaata.
project.colophonBuild: He pae HTML, CSS me JavaScript tūmau, he mea hanga mai i ngā raraunga kua tiakina mā ngā taputapu Python, ka whakaputaina mā GitHub Actions me GitHub Pages. Mā D3 te mahere e tā; ka tautoko a HLS.js i ngā ataata hototahi. Ka whakamahia a Georgia mō ngā pane, me ngā momotuhi pūnaha hei whakakapi.
project.colophonPrivacy: Kāore he pūkete, he tātaritanga whakamahinga, he takawaenga roma rānei. Ka penapenahia te reo ki tō pūtirotiro anake. Ka whakapā pea te purei ki te kaiwhakapāho, ki te kaiwhakarato mana rānei; ka pā hoki ā rātou tikanga tūmataiti.
project.colophonCredits: Kei raro te waehere i te raihana BSD e toru ngā rara. Ka mau tonu ngā whakamihi me ngā raihana ake o ngā whakaahua, haki, mahere, ata me ngā whare pukapuka. He motuhake ngā motika pāho me ngā raraunga pūtake.

iptv.title: Whakamahia ki tētahi taupānga IPTV
iptv.intro: Whakapirihia he URL rārangipāpāho ki tō pūpāpāho. Tāpirihia te URL XMLTV hei aratohu / EPG.
iptv.broader: Ngā hongere tautoko katoa, tae atu ki ngā roma wā hui anake
iptv.note: Kei roto ngā hongere pāpāho tonu me ngā roma mō ngā hui, ngā kaupapa rānei. Kāore pea ētahi e pāho i waenga i ngā hui. He wāhanga noa te aratohu; kāore he rārangi hōtaka mō ētahi hongere.
iptv.failed: Kāore e taea te tārua. Kua tīpakohia te URL hei tārua ā-ringa.
iptv.filterScope: Nō te ao whānui ēnei rārangipāpāho; kāore ngā tātari o te whārangi e whakarerekē i aua rārangi.
iptv.vlcTitle: Ngā tohutohu VLC mō te rorohiko
iptv.vlcCopy: Tāruatia tētahi o ngā URL rārangipāpāho i runga.
iptv.vlcOpen: I VLC, huakina he roma whatunga mā te tahua Media (Windows/Linux), mā te tahua File rānei (macOS).
iptv.vlcPlay: Whakapirihia te URL, kōwhiria Play, Open rānei, kātahi ka kōwhiri hongere i te rārangipāpāho o VLC.
iptv.vlcGuide: Whakamahia te URL rārangipāpāho hei purei ki VLC. He aratohu motuhake te URL XMLTV mō ngā taupānga tautoko; kāore ēnei hipanga e whirihora aratohu XMLTV ki VLC.
